title_zh: 约定限定进化海报中的趋势结论

scenario.label_zh: 限定进化海报中的趋势解释
scenario.goal_zh: 区分图表呈现的变化与原因解释，并约定删除未经支持的普遍优势说法

context_zh: 学生依据课堂提供的虚构鸟类群体图表制作进化主题海报。
author: author-phase10-c

sentences.speaker: Sofia
sentences.text: Our poster calls this an evolutionary success story. Is that too strong?

sentences.speaker: Benji
sentences.text: The chart shows the emergence of a new beak shape over many generations. It does not tell us why the change happened.

sentences.speaker: Sofia
sentences.text: But the later panel shows the dominance of that shape in the sampled population.

sentences.speaker: Benji
sentences.text: Yes, it became the most common shape there. That does not mean it would be best in every environment.

sentences.speaker: Sofia
sentences.text: I will keep the change in frequency and remove the claim that it is universally superior.

sentences.speaker: Benji
sentences.text: Good. Add that the chart alone does not establish the cause of the change.
